reviews.review_title: flying and doing dungeons or find loot !
reviews.review_description:
*** 19 Sept 2026 *** I could tell you all about the game but you see the video's so lets say i'm like for 6 month's one of the  playtester's of this amazing game and in this 6 month's it changed from some good looking VR intergalactic space place to a amazing working game with many things we as playtester wanted to see implemented.
now it in EA so i hope you all like it too what we have for now and subscribe to the discord to help the team out if you see some anomalies that's not Sol Protocol space related of course report it to or better you have great idea's when flying around list them too ;-))
so that we can make this game in warpspeed to go to the next level of development by the team of Singular Perception
